name: Fathom – Your Meeting Intelligence Layer
description: Access your meeting summaries, transcripts, and action items so you can ask questions and build deliverables grounded in what was actually said on your calls. No copy-pasting summaries. No context switching. Just better outputs, faster.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fathom – Your Meeting Intelligence Layer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fathom – Your Meeting Intelligence Layer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fathom.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
